scope: Offline respond only. No live serve, routing, proxy socket, quarantine or release is established.
binding_and_setup: Bind each case and frozen build to its exact guest run, case mode, candidate SHA-256, suite and helper hashes, controller-protected guest identity, process envelopes and cleanup. Do not borrow controls across invocations. The fixture accepts only uid/euid 2000 with matching real/effective gid, compares root-owned protected /etc/bashos-parity-vm and /run/bashos-parity-vm-identity using no-follow opens and stable canonical UUID bytes, and does not support a mapped-user namespace.

Setup must finish successfully without error, timeout or stray processes. Require complete untruncated control.json and request/config fixture tree; parser_control is ok, mode and fixed independently specified request/config match. For hook modes require the fresh-lease check, lease_control create/write/fsync/rename/readback ok and valid hook-control.json with fixed command, expected exit and control environment. A missing, invalid or failed setup control is UNQUALIFIED, never product failure.

All diagnostic envelopes must be valid base64 with byte counts matching decoded bytes and truncated false when present. Establish required stage completion; retain missing, error, truncation and verifier-envelope information rather than inventing bytes.
candidate_stage: After successful setup require candidate status.raw as a complete single decimal line and complete reply.out and reply.err captures. Missing, malformed or truncated raw candidate artifacts are UNQUALIFIED. With valid raw records independently establish and preserve OBSERVED-FAIL for a nonzero candidate status or a complete malformed or incorrect response even if a later snapshot or verifier stage fails.

Decode the complete response hex and DHCP option stream independently: BOOTP reply, fixed transaction/client identity and cookie, complete end marker, no duplicate or truncated options. Relay modes require the selected pool address, mask and gateway, echoed giaddr and verbatim option 82. PXE matching mode requires siaddr, option 66, option 67, BOOTP file and the exact 6/8/9/10 suboptions including the length-prefixed menu entry; nonmatching mode requires options 43/66/67 and BOOTP file absent. Complete mismatches are OBSERVED-FAIL.

The status file candidate-status.json is verifier-produced, not a candidate-stage prerequisite. If present it must agree with status.raw and the lengths of reply.out and reply.err; malformed or inconsistent data is UNQUALIFIED for any conclusion relying on it. Missing candidate-status.json or a verifier crash must not erase a product mismatch already independently established from complete valid candidate-stage artifacts. If no product mismatch is established and the verifier is absent, nonzero or emits unexpected output, the proposed pass is UNQUALIFIED.
lease_stage: For each hook mode require snapshot.status.raw exactly 0 newline, snapshot.out and snapshot.err empty, and complete lease-snapshot.json for the same mode, recorded after candidate status.raw and before verification. Failed or missing snapshot-stage infrastructure is UNQUALIFIED for lease and hook conclusions, but does not erase independently established earlier candidate response failures.

Require nonnegative monotonic elapsed time and absolute difference between wall and monotonic elapsed no greater than two seconds. Validate snapshot JSON types and, for a regular lease, strict base64 bytes, matching size and bytes_read at most 4096 and the recorded runner tree kind and bytes; retain snapshot device/inode as diagnostics. A clock discontinuity, malformed or incomplete capture, or unreadable snapshot is UNQUALIFIED.

Given successful writable/rename setup controls and a complete snapshot, a missing/nonregular lease or a complete wrong lease record is OBSERVED-FAIL for the lease-dependent clause. Independently require exactly one ASCII line: MAC 02:00:00:00:00:11, IP 192.0.2.100, integer expiry and hostname fixture-host; expiry minus 3600 must be between the integer wall-clock seconds in setup control and snapshot, allowing two seconds on either side for bounded wall-clock drift. No candidate-produced interpretation is an oracle.

For hook-commit and hook-failure require valid post-candidate hook.json equal to ACTION=commit, MAC=02:00:00:00:00:11, IP=192.0.2.100, HOSTNAME=fixture-host, LEASE_TIME=3600. Missing hook.json after completed candidate and intact controls is OBSERVED-FAIL; hook-missing must have no hook.json. Hook data and the committed lease must be from the same completed invocation.
joint_hook_comparison: For r6 require independently qualified candidate-response observations from hook-commit, hook-failure and hook-missing, each with successful per-invocation setup and hook controls, from the same frozen build with identical controlled request and fresh pool/lease settings. Hook-failure must also retain the expected post-candidate hook record, proving the fixed failing stub was reached; the missing-hook control must prove the fixed private path was absent. Compare the full decoded ACK bytes and candidate status across the three cases. Missing baseline or incomplete response/control evidence is UNQUALIFIED for r6; complete unequal replies or statuses are OBSERVED-FAIL. Hook stderr may differ.

The r6 reply comparison is independent of the r4 lease requirement: preserve a qualified reply observation or a reached reply mismatch when a later lease snapshot or verifier is incomplete or a separately established lease mismatch occurs. Do not promote it to r4 coverage. For r4, hook-commit must separately establish the committed lease and matching hook environment.
qualification: No raw runner label constitutes qualification. Apply qualification separately to each original requirement: QUALIFIED-PASS requires all applicable setup, capture, candidate and requirement-specific controls; OBSERVED-FAIL requires a complete independently established mismatch and retains any later infrastructure issue separately; otherwise UNQUALIFIED. Never promote an incomplete late stage to an earlier successful stage.

requirements.dhcpd/relay-proxy-pxe:r1: relay-a and relay-b proposals; no live routing
requirements.dhcpd/relay-proxy-pxe:r5: partial: matching and nonmatching offline options; nonmatching siaddr unresolved
requirements.dhcpd/decline-release-and-hook:r4: offline commit hook and committed lease proposal
requirements.dhcpd/decline-release-and-hook:r6: same-build success, failing and missing hook ACK comparison

limits: No result is claimed until independent peer review, isolated guest execution and primary application of this gate.
